data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250 caught, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That supports $10,000 each every month without risking collapse. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. If stock later falls below 500, let's cap total catch at half the stock and share that cap equally.
